mechanism: Piroxicam (NSAID) may reduce the efficacy of levodopa through inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis and potential antagonism of dopaminergic effects, while increasing risk of GI complications and renal impairment affecting carbidopa-levodopa clearance.
action: Monitor for reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy and GI symptoms; consider alternative analgesia (acetaminophen or selective COX-2 inhibitors); ensure adequate renal function monitoring and gastroprotection if NSAID continuation necessary.
